source_snapshot.procedure: Run power-cycle stress while continuously GETting `/redfish/v1/Systems`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; inferred ipmitool off/on and hardcoded insecure curl.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: CRITICAL; requires phase-aware 503 semantics and bounded authorized cycling.

old_problem: `Power cycle` does not identify host/DC/AC/BMC boundary, count or timing, and a host-off BMC may legitimately return 2xx while AC loss yields no HTTP. The exact server-originated 503 phase and recovery are absent.
disposition_reason: ED-06 and ED-18 prohibit conflating warm/cold/AC/DC transitions and require OFF→ON→OS Ready. HTTP 503 is an application response, not a transport failure. No standard dictates this platform's 503 phase; inventing it or generic cycling would violate safety and acceptance rules.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2251 and 2252, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve repeated power-transition stress, continuous Systems GET and literal 503 coverage.
Require exact controller/domain, cycle count, off/on/dwell/stabilization and complete OFF→ON→OS Ready phase markers.
Classify DNS, TCP, TLS, authentication, HTTP status/headers/body and Redfish PowerState separately; only a received server 503 qualifies.
Require workload drain, independent console, aborts and post-cycle 2xx/final health; never retry a failed cycle automatically.
No credentials, GET, power action, cycle, reboot or DUT operation occurred.

test_case.test_name: Phase-locked Redfish HTTP 503 during approved power-cycle stress
test_case.purpose: Verify a genuine server-originated 503 from `/redfish/v1/Systems` in the platform-defined transient phase of each approved power cycle and prove normal Redfish/OS recovery afterward.
required_package: SUT/BMC firmware and exact power-domain/controller mapping
Defined 503 phase/window/headers/body and per-cycle occurrence rule
TLS credentials, bounded polling, workload drain, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: After explicit cycle-plan approval, capture a TLS-valid 2xx baseline, correlate bounded GET polling with controller-supplied OFF/ON/BMC/OS phase markers, record each network-layer outcome, and verify 2xx plus OS Ready after every cycle; power actions remain separately authorized.
test_case.expected_result: Each required cycle produces the exact genuine 503 only in the signed transition window, never substitutes connection failure, and returns to approved 2xx/PowerState and OS Ready within timeout with healthy final state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved cycle and 503 phase oracles, required genuine 503 occurrences, full OFF→ON→OS Ready evidence and recovery. Wrong/missing 503, transport failure counted as 503, missed readiness or abnormal health is FAIL; absent phase semantics keeps Pending.
safety_gate: Dedicated drained SUT and verified controller/domain.
Explicit count/timing authorization; no inferred or automatic repeat.
TLS/secret protection and bounded polling load.
Abort on power, boot, storage, thermal, BMC or readiness fault.
expected_evidence: Authorized cycle plan and readiness oracle
Per-attempt monotonic phase plus DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP classification
Per-cycle OFF/ON/OS Ready, final health, abort/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: On any abnormal cycle stop the sequence, preserve controller/console/Redfish/SEL evidence and use only the pre-approved independent recovery; do not retry.
